Definition: Rithmah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: The name is Rithmah, a place in the Desert. You find the name in Numbers 33:18, "…they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah", and again in Numbers 33:19.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Rithmah counts, because the God of the Bible works in places you can find. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
